"""Publish actual V164 restored-smoke,unit checks and original-live readiness."""
import json
import shutil
import time
from pathlib import Path

import psutil
import torch
import numpy as np
from train_directional_bank_trial import guard,read,ref,save
from train_v43_quality_trial import live
from demosaic.prediction_archive import fingerprint

repo=Path('/home/dllu/proj/demosaic');root=repo/'.cache/quality-20261107/V164-pair-unit-floor-v1'
plan=read(root/'plan-v1.json');guard(plan);post=read(root/'postprocess-plan-v1.json');guard(post)
smoke=read(root/'smoke-result-v1.json');assert smoke['counts']==smoke['updates']=={'phase-control':10,'fine-pair':10}
assert smoke['exact_V163_control_trace_rows']==10
state=torch.load(smoke['checkpoint']['path'],map_location='cpu',weights_only=True)
finite=0
for arm in state['arms']:
    assert state['arms'][arm]['parameter_tensors']==47
    assert len(state['models'][arm])==len(state['emas'][arm])==len(state['optimizers'][arm]['state'])==47
    assert all(float(s['step'])==10 for s in state['optimizers'][arm]['state'].values())
    assert all(torch.isfinite(v).all() for key in ['models','emas'] for v in state[key][arm].values())
    assert all(torch.isfinite(v).all() for s in state['optimizers'][arm]['state'].values() for v in s.values());finite+=47
assert finite==94 and all(min(v.values())>0 for v in smoke['parameter_maximum_gradients'].values())
parity=read(root/'parity-result-v1.json');assert len(parity['rows'])==28 and parity['component_forward_evaluations']==56
anchor=parity['CUDA_anchor_loss_checks'];pair=parity['CUDA_pair_unit_loss_checks']
assert len(anchor)==10 and len(pair)==6 and all(v['neural_forwards']==0 and v['leaf_backwards']==1 for v in anchor+pair)
table=read(plan['pair_unit_table']['path'])['rows']
snapshot=root/'readiness-training-prefix-v1.jsonl';assert not snapshot.exists()
with (root/'train-trace-v1.jsonl').open() as stream:lines=[next(stream) for _ in range(40)]
rows=[json.loads(s) for s in lines];baseline=read(plan['baseline_training']['path'])['trace']
for i,row in enumerate(rows):
    old=baseline[i];assert all(row[k]==old[k] for k in ['step','batch','domain','flat_target_mask'])
    expected=old['arms']['harmonic-phase'];assert {k:row['arms']['phase-control'][k] for k in expected}==expected
    for arm,key,floor in [('phase-control','control_units_FP32',16),('fine-pair','candidate_units_FP32',2)]:
        entry=table[i];values=np.array(entry[key],dtype=np.float32).reshape(entry['shape'])
        assert row['arms'][arm]['pair_unit_values']==fingerprint(values)
        assert row['arms'][arm]['pair_unit_floor_DN16']==floor
snapshot.write_text(''.join(lines))
status=read(root/'status-v1.json');queued=read(root/'postprocess-status-v1.json')
assert status['status']=='running-declared-phase' and status['phase']=='train'
assert queued['status']=='waiting-for-original-training-owner'
owners=[]
for role,o in [('training-controller',status['owner']),('train-worker',status['child']),('review-controller',queued['owner'])]:
    assert live(o);owners.append({'role':role,**o,'argv':psutil.Process(o['pid']).cmdline()})
snapshot_live=root/'prepared-live-snapshot-v1.json';assert not snapshot_live.exists()
save(snapshot_live,{'recorded_unix_UTC':time.time(),'training':status,'postprocess':queued,
    'progress':read(root/'train-progress-v1.json'),'observed_live_owners':owners,
    'scope':'Historical original-live snapshot,not final counts or trained quality. Original workers continue once.'})
audit=root/'readiness-audit-v1.json';assert not audit.exists()
save(audit,{'status':'pass-restored-smoke-exact-control-prefix-and-unit-traces',
    'smoke':ref(root/'smoke-result-v1.json'),'finite_Adam_states_at10':94,
    'all94_parameter_tensors_have_finite_nonzero_prefix_gradients':True,'exact_V163_control_prefix_rows':40,
    'exact_training_masks_and_pair_unit_records':40,'training_prefix':ref(snapshot),
    'smoke_peak_CUDA_bytes':smoke['CUDA_peak_allocated_bytes'],
    'independent_CUDA_anchor_leaf_backwards':10,'independent_CUDA_pair_leaf_backwards':6,
    'maximum_CUDA_pair_loss_adjoint_difference':max(v['maximum_adjoint_difference'] for v in pair),
    'maximum_CUDA_anchor_loss_adjoint_difference':max(v['maximum_adjoint_difference'] for v in anchor),
    'new_neural_forwards':0,'source':dict(ref(Path(__file__)),text=Path(__file__).read_text())})
dest=repo/'docs/results/v164-pair-unit-floor-preparation-v1';dest.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
names={'plan.json':'plan-v1.json','quality-design.json':'quality-design-v1.json','CPU-readiness.json':'CPU-readiness-v1.json',
    'parity.json':'parity-result-v1.json','smoke.json':'smoke-result-v1.json','readiness-audit.json':'readiness-audit-v1.json',
    'training-prefix.jsonl':snapshot.name,'live-snapshot.json':snapshot_live.name,'postprocess-imports.json':'postprocess-import-preflight-v1.json',
    'postprocess-plan.json':'postprocess-plan-v1.json','retained-native-comparators.json':'native-retained-comparators-v1.json'}
originals={name:root/path for name,path in names.items()}
originals.update({'unit-audit.json':Path(plan['pair_unit_table']['path']),
    'motivation-audit.json':repo/'docs/results/v164-objective-motivation-v1.json',
    'CPU-regression.log':repo/'.cache/v164-CPU-regression-v1.log','new-unit-tests.log':repo/'.cache/v164-pair-unit-tests-v1.log',
    'document-helper-failure.json':repo/'.cache/v164-document-update-failure-v1.json'})
copies={}
for name,p in originals.items():
    q=dest/name;shutil.copyfile(p,q);assert p.read_bytes()==q.read_bytes();copies[name]={'original':ref(p),'public':ref(q)}
paths=list((Path(plan['work'])/'scripts').glob('*.py'))+list((Path(plan['work'])/'configs').glob('*'))
paths+=list((root/'postprocess-v1/scripts').glob('*.py'))
tests=read(root/'CPU-readiness-v1.json')['tests']['command'].split(' pytest ',1)[1].split(' -q')[0].split()
paths += [repo/p for p in tests]
paths += [repo/p for p in ['scripts/pair_unit_floor.py','scripts/train_pair_unit_floor_trial.py',
    'scripts/review_pair_unit_floor_trial.py','configs/quality-v143-pair-unit-floor-v164.yaml',
    '.cache/audit-v164-motivation-v1.py','.cache/build-v164-controller-v1.py','.cache/prepare-v164-postprocess-v1.py',
    '.cache/launch-v164-v1.py','.cache/queue-v164-review-v1.py','.cache/launch-v164-queue-v1.py']]
paths=list(dict.fromkeys(paths))
neural={p:h for p,h in plan['frozen_files'].items() if Path(p).parent.name=='demosaic'};assert len(neural)==89
for p,h in neural.items():assert ref(repo/'src/demosaic'/Path(p).name)['sha256']==h
bundle=dest/'source-bundle-v1.json';save(bundle,{'source_texts':[dict(ref(p),text=p.read_text()) for p in paths],
    'unchanged_neural_hashes':neural,'publisher':dict(ref(Path(__file__)),text=Path(__file__).read_text())})
index=repo/'docs/results/v164-pair-unit-floor-preparation-v1.json';assert not index.exists()
save(index,{'status':'ready-original-training-live-quality-pending','recorded_unix_UTC':time.time(),'copies':copies,
    'sources':ref(bundle),'source_texts':len(paths),'unchanged_neural_sources':89,'new_neural_modules':0,
    'parameters_per_head':124909,'parameter_tensors_per_head':47,'pair_unit_floors_DN16':{'control':16,'candidate':2},
    'flat_anchor_weight_both':.25,'actual_CPU_tests':199,'new_unit_checks':19,
    'compatibility_contexts':28,'compatibility_head_calls':56,'additional_leaf_output_CUDA_backwards':16,
    'discarded_smoke_head_calls':20,'finite_Adam_states_after_restored_smoke':94,'exact_V163_control_prefix_rows':40,
    'fixed_heads':2,'fixed_endpoints':4,'steps_per_head':1000,'review_cases':822,'planned_review_calls':3288,
    'planned_total_scientific_head_calls_excluding_tests':5364,'planned_head_image_evaluations':11424,
    'planned_new_prediction_arrays':1644,'planned_native_images':72,'planned_triplets':24,'retained_native_columns':8,
    'planned_native_RGB_channels':61824000,'quality_complete':False,'performance_native_viewing_complete':False,
    'new_parent_DINO_source_noise_calls':0,'original_lookups':0,'RAW_decodes':0,'scope':plan['scope']})
assert not torch.cuda.is_initialized()
print('Published',len(copies),'exact receipts,',len(paths),'source texts,89 unchanged neural modules,40 exact control/unit records;original3 owners live')
